description: Re-prove stored credentials by calling each platform's own API and recording the real result. Nothing else re-tests a credential after it is connected, so a stored key that the provider has since revoked keeps reading as connected. Defaults to only the credentials whose proof is missing or stale. A provider that cannot be reached is reported, never recorded as a failure.

include_fresh.description: Also re-test credentials whose proof is still fresh (default false).

max.description: Most credentials to test in one call, 1-100 (default 25).

platform.description: Recheck one platform. Omit to sweep every stored credential.

name: keychain_recheck
